81100.meaning1: as soon as; no sooner than

examples.text: tassa ekādasahatthena pādena dvādasahatthāya kaṇṇikāya akkantamattāya navaghaṭappamāṇo reṇu uṭṭhāya aṭṭhapaṇṇāsahatthaṃ padesaṃ uggantvā okiṇṇamanosilācuṇṇaṃ viya paccokiṇṇo.

81101.meaning1: to observe; to perceive; to discern

examples.text: yathā rukkhānaṃ pupphaphalapallavehi atthikā, tāni sukhena gahetuṃ sakkonti. yathā ca bhūmiyaṃ ṭhitā esa rājā, esa uparājā, esa senāpatī'ti sallakkhetuṃ sakkonti. ṭhān'ādīsu ca iriyāpathesu yo yena icchati, so ten'eva gacchati.

81102.meaning1: desire to speak; wish to talk (to)
81102.commentary: (DNa) katamā kathetu'kamyatā pucchā? bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ kathetu'kamyatāya pañhaṃ pucchati. cattāro'me, bhikkhave, satipaṭṭhānā. katame cattāro?… aṭṭh'ime bhikkhave magg'aṅgā. katame aṭṭhā'ti, ayaṃ kathetu'kamyatā pucchā.

examples.text: tattha pucchā nāma adiṭṭhajotanā pucchā, diṭṭhasaṃsandanā pucchā, vimaticchedanā pucchā, anumatipucchā, kathetu'kamyatā pucchā'ti pañcavidhā hoti.

81103.meaning1: desire to listen; wanting to hear (for)

examples.text: evaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ca pasatthabhāv'ānurūpaṃ attano dhāraṇabalaṃ dassento sattānaṃ sotu'kamyataṃ janeti evaṃ me sutaṃ, tañ'ca kho atthato vā byañjanato vā anūnaman'adhikaṃ, evam'eva na aññathā daṭṭhabban'ti.

81105.commentary: (DNt) anupubbapadavaṇṇanā'ti anukkamena padavaṇṇanā, padaṃ padaṃ pati anukkamena vaṇṇanā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. pubbe vuttañ'hi, uttānaṃ vā padam'aññatra vaṇṇanā'pi anupubbapadavaṇṇanā' tv'eva vuccati. evañ'ca katvā apubbapadavaṇṇanā'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, pubbe avaṇṇitapadavaṇṇanā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutan'ti mahāparinibbānasuttaṃ. tatr'āyam'anupubbapadavaṇṇanā, gijjhakūṭe'ti gijjhā tassa kūṭesu vasiṃsu, gijjhasadisaṃ vā tassa kūṭaṃ atthī'ti gijjhakūṭo, tasmiṃ gijjhakūṭe. abhiyātu'kāmo'ti abhibhavan'atthāya yātu'kāmo.

81106.meaning1: dissolving; stopping; ending; ceasing; disappearing; vanishing
81106.construction:
ni + rujjha + ana + ka
nirujjhana + ka
81106.commentary: (SNt) nirujjhanakasabhāvan'ti khaṇabhaṅgavasena pabhaṅgusabhāvaṃ. (ANt) aṭṭhame cittassa parivattanaṃ uppādanirodhā evā'ti āha, evaṃ lahuṃ uppajjitvā lahuṃ nirujjhanakan'ti.

examples.text: virāgadhamman'ti virajjanakasabhāvaṃ. nirodhadhamman'ti nirujjhanakasabhāvaṃ.
evaṃ lahuparivattan'ti evaṃ lahuṃ uppajjitvā lahuṃ nirujjhanakaṃ.

tattha viparītacittassa vatthumhi sati viññatti, ayaṃ cittavipallāso. tattha viparītacittassa tamhi rūpe asubhe subhan'ti yā khanti ruci upekkhanā nicchayo diṭṭhi nidassanaṃ santīraṇā, ayaṃ diṭṭhivipallāso.

81108.commentary: (VINa) cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā'ti ettha cuṇṇamattikānaṃ abhisaṅkharaṇakālato paṭṭhāya sabbapayogesu dukkaṭaṃ.

examples.text: kuladūsako'ti kulāni dūseti pupphena vā phalena vā cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā dantakaṭṭhena vā veḷuyā vā vejjikāya vā jaṅghapesanikena vā.

81109.commentary: (MNa) vo'ti ayaṃ vo-saddo paccatta-upayoga-karaṇa-sampadāna-sāmivacana-padapūraṇesu dissati. kacci pana vo, anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā'ti-ādīsu (ma. ni. 1.326) hi paccatte dissati.

examples.text: kacci pana vo, anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathā'ti?

evaṃ sabbā taṇhā ajjhosānalakkhaṇena ekalakkhaṇā, api tu ārammaṇa-upādānavasena aññam'aññehi nāmehi abhilapitā icchā-iti'pi taṇhā-iti'pi sallo-iti'pi dhūpāyanā-iti'pi saritā-iti'pi visattikā-iti'pi sineho-iti'pi kilamatho-iti'pi latā-iti'pi maññanā-iti'pi bandho-iti'pi āsā-iti'pi pipāsā-iti'pi abhinandanā-iti'pi, iti sabbā taṇhā ajjhosānalakkhaṇena ekalakkhaṇā.

81113.synonym: utta, udita, udīrita, kathita, pabhāvita, pavutta, byākkhāta, bhaṭṭha, bhaṇita, bhāsita, lapita, vutta, samudāciṇṇa
81113.commentary: (NPa) abhilapitan'ti vuttaṃ yaṃ idaṃ abhilapanaṃ, idaṃ bāhirānaṃ rūp'ādīnaṃ vatthūnaṃ ārammaṇavasena, ārammaṇakaraṇavasena vā yojetabbaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ sabbā taṇhā ajjhosānalakkhaṇena ekalakkhaṇā, api tu ārammaṇa-upādānavasena aññam'aññehi nāmehi abhilapitā icchā-iti'pi taṇhā-iti'pi sallo-iti'pi dhūpāyanā-iti'pi saritā-iti'pi visattikā-iti'pi sineho-iti'pi kilamatho-iti'pi latā-iti'pi maññanā-iti'pi bandho-iti'pi āsā-iti'pi pipāsā-iti'pi abhinandanā-iti'pi, iti sabbā taṇhā ajjhosānalakkhaṇena ekalakkhaṇā.

81114.commentary: (NPt) yaṃ idaṃ… ārammaṇakaraṇavasena vā abhilapanan'ti evaṃ kiriyāparāmasanaṃ yojetabban'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: abhilapitan'ti vuttaṃ yaṃ idaṃ abhilapanaṃ, idaṃ bāhirānaṃ rūp'ādīnaṃ vatthūnaṃ ārammaṇavasena, ārammaṇakaraṇavasena vā yojetabbaṃ.

brāhmaṇo tasmim'pi patiṭṭhātuṃ asakkonto alaṃ, bho, na īdisassa purisassa santikaṃ āgatena ajānitvā gantuṃ vaṭṭati, sakavādaṃ pahāya samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ anuvattitvā mayhaṃ atthaṃ gavesissāmi, paralokamaggaṃ sodhessāmī'ti sanniṭṭhānaṃ katvā satthāraṃ āyācanto na kho ahan'ti-ādim'āha.
vappakāle'ti vappanakāle bījanikkhepasamaye.
tam'ahaṃ upasaṅkamma, saraṇaṃ gantvāna satthuno, sambuddhappamukhaṃ saṅghaṃ, gandhamālena pūjayiṃ, pūjetvā gandhamālena, gavapānena tappayiṃ.
pallaṅkena nisajjāya, ṭhānacaṅkamanena ca, vītināmenti te rattiṃ, mama sissā durāsadā.

81119.commentary: (VSa) luvakacammaparikkhaṭā'ti pakkhibiḷālacammaparikkhaṭā. (PYt) pakkhibiḷālo'ti tuliyo. so hi pakkhayuttattā ca biḷālamukhasadisamukhattā ca pakkhibiḷālo'ti vuccati. iminā luvakacammaparikkhatā'ti ettha luvakasaddo pakkhibiḷālapariyāyo'ti dasseti. ulūkacammaparikkhatā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: na luvakacammaparikkhaṭā upāhanā dhāretabbā.

81120.grammar: prp of na āyūhati, neg, intrans

examples.text: kathaṃ nu tvaṃ, mārisa, ogham'atarī'ti? appatiṭṭhaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.
cirassaṃ vata passāmi, brāhmaṇaṃ parinibbutaṃ, appatiṭṭhaṃ anāyūhaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ loke visattikan'ti.
mahāsamudde udakaṃ, ākāso ca vasun'dharā, parimeyyāni etāni, appameyyo'si cakkhuma.

81122.meaning1: resenting; bearing a grudge; harbouring enmity

examples.text: ayaṃ pan'ettha vacan'attho, kodhanā'ti kujjhanasīlā. upanāhī'ti upanāhanasīlā, upanāho vā etesaṃ atthī'ti upanāhī. tathā makkhī palāsī ca.
bhiyyo pañcasate ñatvā, vane kāpilavatthave, tato āmantayī satthā, sāvake sāsane rate.

81125.commentary: (VVa) hemavatā'ti himavati jātā, hemavatajātikā vā. te hi mahantā thāmajavasampannā ca honti.

examples.text: sataṃ hemavatā nāgā, īsādantā urūḷhavā, suvaṇṇakacchā mātaṅgā, hemakappanavāsasā, etassācāmadānassa, kalaṃ n'āgghati soḷasiṃ.

81126.commentary: (DNt) rahass'aṅgan'ti bījaṃ sandhāya vadati. (APt) rahasi ṭhāne jātaṃ aṅgaṃ rahass'aṅgaṃ, sattamiy'ālopo, issattaṃ, sassa dvittañ'ca.

examples.text: kumbhaṇḍānan'ti te kira devā mah'odarā honti, rahass'aṅgam'pi ca nesaṃ kumbho viya mahantaṃ hoti. tasmā kumbhaṇḍā'ti vuccanti.

81127.meaning1: names of a group of nāgas
81127.commentary: (DNa) ath'āguṃ nāgasā nāgā, vesālā sahatacchakā'ti nāgasadahavāsikā ca vesālīvāsikā ca nāgā saha tacchakanāgaparisāya āgatā'ti attho.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ nāgasā nāgā, vesālā sahatacchakā, kambal'assatarā āguṃ, pāyāgā saha ñātibhi.

81128.commentary: (DNa) sabbe verocanāmakā'ti sabbe attano mātulassa rāhuss'eva nāmadharā.

examples.text: satañ'ca baliputtānaṃ, sabbe verocanāmakā, sannayhitvā balisenaṃ, rāhubhaddam'upāgamuṃ, samayodāni bhaddante, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

81129.meaning1: name of a group of nāgas
81129.commentary: (DNa) varuṇā vāraṇā devā, somo ca yasasā sahā'ti varuṇadevatā, vāraṇadevatā, somadevatā'ti evaṃ nāmakā ca devā yasasā nāma devena sahāgatā'ti attho.

examples.text: āpo ca devā pathavī, tejo vāyo tadāgamuṃ, varuṇā vāraṇā devā, somo ca yasasā saha.

81130.meaning1: name of a group of deities
81130.construction:
na > a + sama + ā
asama + ā
81130.commentary: (DNa) asamā ca duve yamā'ti asamadevatā ca dve ca yamakā devā.

examples.text: veṇḍudevā sahali ca, asamā ca duve yamā, candass'ūpanisā devā, candam'āguṃ purakkhatvā.
uppathapaṭipanne sindhave vīthi-āropan'atthaṃ patodo viya uppathe dhāvanakaṃ kūṭacittaṃ vīthi-āropan'atthaṃ vijjhatī'ti patodo viya patodo.

81132.meaning1: name of a group of deities

examples.text: ath'āguṃ harayo devā, ye ca lohitavāsino, pāragā mahāpāragā, āguṃ devā yasassino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.

81133.meaning1: name of a group of deities
81133.construction:
pa > pā + mukha > mokkha + *ya + ā
pāmokkha + ā

examples.text: sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā saha, odātagayhā pāmokkhā, āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā.

81134.commentary: (DNa) saṭṭh'ete devanikāyā'ti ete ca āpo ca devā'ti-ādikā cha dasakā saṭṭhi devanikāyā sabbe nīl'ādivasena nānattavaṇṇino.

examples.text: saṭṭh'ete devanikāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino, nām'anvayena āgacchuṃ, ye c'aññe sadisā saha.

81135.meaning1: left behind; living away from; living abroad
81135.commentary: (DNa) tass'attho, pavuṭṭhā vigatā jāti assā'ti ariyasaṅgho pavuṭṭhajāti nāma, taṃ pavuṭṭhajātiṃ (DNt) pavutthāti pavāsaṃ gatā viya apetā'ti āha vigatā'ti. pavutthā vā pakārato vutthā vusitā, tena jāti vusitabbā assā'ti pavuṭṭhajāti.

examples.text: pañcavīsāya khalu, samma puṇṇamukha, ṭhānehi itthī paduṭṭhā veditabbā bhavati. sāmikassa pavāsaṃ vaṇṇeti, pavuṭṭhaṃ na sarati, āgataṃ n'ābhinandati, avaṇṇaṃ tassa bhaṇati, vaṇṇaṃ tassa na bhaṇati, anatthaṃ tassa carati, atthaṃ tassa na carati
pavutthajātiṃ akhilaṃ, oghatiṇṇamanāsavaṃ, dakkhemoghataraṃ nāgaṃ, candaṃva asitātigaṃ.

81137.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of majjha (+gen)
81137.commentary: (DNa) tesañ'ca majjhato āga, hārito parivārito'ti tesaṃ brahmānaṃ majjhe hārito nāma mahābrahmā satasahassabrahmaparivāro āgato.

examples.text: das'ettha issarā āguṃ, paccekavasavattino, tesañ'ca majjhato āga, hārito parivārito.

81141.commentary: (DNa) mārasenā abhikkantā, te vijānātha bhikkhavo'ti bhikkhave mārasenā abhikkantā, te tumhe attano anurūpaṃ vijānātha, phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjathāti vadati.

examples.text: mārasenā abhikkantā, te vijānātha bhikkhavo, te ca ātappam'akaruṃ, sutvā buddhassa sāsanaṃ, vītarāgehi pakkāmuṃ, nesaṃ lomā'pi iñjayuṃ.

81142.meaning1: terrifying thing; dreadful spectacle; fearful sight
81142.construction:
vi + bhiṃsa + ana + ka
vibhiṃsana + ka

examples.text: tadā so paccudāvattī'ti tasmiṃ samaye so māro taṃ vibhiṃsanakaṃ dassetvā paṭinivatto.

81143.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anucariyā (+gen)
81143.commentary: (DNa) evaṃ bhaddaṃ tavā'ti… anucariyaṃ sahacaraṇaṃ ekato gamanaṃ upāgami. (DNt) anucariyan'ti anucaraṇabhāvaṃ, taṃ pan'assa anucaraṇaṃ nāma saddhiṃ gamanam'evā'ti āha sahacaraṇaṃ ekato gamanan'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ bhaddantavā'ti kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto sakkassa devānam'indassa paṭissutvā beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya sakkassa devānam'indassa anucariyaṃ upāgami.

81146.commentary: (DNa) durupasaṅkamā'ti dupayirupāsiyā. ahaṃ sarāgo sadoso samoho, satthā vītarāgo vītadoso vītamoho, tasmā dupayirupāsiyā tathāgatā mādisena.

examples.text: atha kho sakko devānam'indo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi, durupasaṅkamā kho, tāta pañcasikha, tathāgatā mādisena, jhāyī jhānaratā, tadantaraṃ paṭisallīnā.

81148.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of atidūra
81148.meaning1: very far away; a great distance off

examples.text: evaṃ bhaddantavā'ti kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto sakkassa devānam'indassa paṭissutvā beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ ādāya yena indasālaguhā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ettāvatā me bhagavā n'eva atidūre bhavissati n'āccāsanne, saddañ'ca me sossatī'ti ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

81149.meaning1: to stick; to cling; to adhere; to attach (to)

examples.text: apica kho niddhantalohapiṇḍaṃ viya makkhikā, bhagavantaṃ allīyituṃ asamatthā'va ahesuṃ.

81150.meaning1: making grow; causing to increase; generating

examples.text: ānandajananī mamā'ti mayhaṃ pītisomanassavaḍḍhanī.

81151.commentary: (DNa) aṅgīrasī'ti aṅge rasmiyo assā'ti aṅgīrasī, tam'eva ārabbha ālapanto vadati.

examples.text: vāto'va sedataṃ kanto, pānīyaṃ'va pipāsato, aṅgīrasi piyāme'si, dhammo arahatām'iva.
ettha tuttaṃ vuccati kaṇṇamūle vijjhana-ayadaṇḍako. tomaran'ti pād'ādīsu vijjhanadaṇḍatomaraṃ.
appako vata me santo, kāmo vellitakesiyā, anekabhāvo samuppādi, arahante'va dakkhiṇā.

81154.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of saṇhika

examples.text: āmakamatte'ti āmake n'ātisukkhe bhājane. kumbhakāro hi āmakaṃ n'ātisukkhaṃ apakkaṃ ubhohi hatthehi saṇhikaṃ gaṇhāti mā bhijjatū'ti. iti yathā kumbhakāro tattha paṭipajjati, n'āhaṃ tumhesu tathā paṭipajjissāmi.

81155.meaning2: further and further; furthermore; in addition

81158.meaning1: diverse groups of beings; various hosts

examples.text: evaṃ sukhī hotu, pañcasikha, sakko devānam'indo sāmacco saparijano, sukhakāmā hi devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye c'aññe santi puthukāyā'ti.
upanaccantiyā'ti naccamānāya.

81163.meaning1: with three connections; composed of three parts
81163.commentary: (MNt) hetuphalasandhi, phalahetusandhi, puna hetuphalasandhī'ti evaṃ tayo sandhī etassā'ti tisandhi, taṃ tisandhiṃ.

examples.text: ettāvatā yaṃ bodhirukkhamūle aparājitapallaṅke nisinno sammasitvā sabbaññutaṃ patto, tassa paṭiccasamuppādassa paṭivedhā maññanānaṃ abhāvakāraṇaṃ dassento catusaṅkhepaṃ tisandhiṃ ti'y'addhaṃ vīsat'ākāraṃ tam'eva paṭiccasamuppādaṃ dasseti.

81164.commentary: (MNt) te pana atīte hetusaṅkhepo, eta'r'ahi phalasaṅkhepo, eta'r'ahi hetusaṅkhepo, āyatiṃ phalasaṅkhepo'ti cattāro saṅkhepā etassā'ti catusaṅkhepo, taṃ catusaṅkhepaṃ.

examples.text: ettāvatā yaṃ bodhirukkhamūle aparājitapallaṅke nisinno sammasitvā sabbaññutaṃ patto, tassa paṭiccasamuppādassa paṭivedhā maññanānaṃ abhāvakāraṇaṃ dassento catusaṅkhepaṃ tisandhiṃ ti'y'addhaṃ vīsat'ākāraṃ tam'eva paṭiccasamuppādaṃ dasseti.

81165.commentary: (MNt) atīta-paccuppann'ānāgata-bhedā tayo addhā etassā'ti tiyaddho, taṃ tiyaddhaṃ.

examples.text: ettāvatā yaṃ bodhirukkhamūle aparājitapallaṅke nisinno sammasitvā sabbaññutaṃ patto, tassa paṭiccasamuppādassa paṭivedhā maññanānaṃ abhāvakāraṇaṃ dassento catusaṅkhepaṃ tisandhiṃ ti'y'addhaṃ vīsat'ākāraṃ tam'eva paṭiccasamuppādaṃ dasseti.

81166.meaning1: in twenty ways; having twenty aspects
81166.commentary: (MNt) sarūpato avuttā'pi tasmiṃ tasmiṃ saṅkhepe ākirīyanti avijjāsaṅkhār'ādi-ggahaṇehi pakāsīyantī'ti ākārā, atītahetu'ādīnaṃ vā pakārā ākārā, te ek'ekasaṅkhepe pañca pañca katvā vīsati ākārā etassā'ti vīsatākāro, taṃ vīsatākāraṃ

examples.text: ettāvatā yaṃ bodhirukkhamūle aparājitapallaṅke nisinno sammasitvā sabbaññutaṃ patto, tassa paṭiccasamuppādassa paṭivedhā maññanānaṃ abhāvakāraṇaṃ dassento catusaṅkhepaṃ tisandhiṃ ti'y'addhaṃ vīsat'ākāraṃ tam'eva paṭiccasamuppādaṃ dasseti.
yā hi taṇhā khīṇā, virattā'pi tā bhavanti niruddhā'pi cattā'pi paṭinissaṭṭhā'pi. khayā'ti vā catumaggakicca-sādhāraṇam'etaṃ.

81168.commentary: (MNt) uttaravirahitan'ti attānaṃ uttarituṃ samatthattā uttarena adhikena virahitaṃ.

examples.text: anuttaran'ti uttaravirahitaṃ sabbaseṭṭhaṃ.

ekena puthujjanavārena ekena sekkhavārena catūhi khīṇ'āsavavārehi dvīhi tathāgatavārehī'ti aṭṭhahi mahāvārehi ekam'ekasmiñ'ca vāre pathavī-ādīhi catuvīsatiyā antaravārehi paṭimaṇḍetvā dvebhāṇavāra-parimāṇāya tantiyā avoca.

81170.meaning1: of benefit in the present and in the future
81170.commentary: (MNt) sabbam'pi sippan'ti aṭṭhārasa-vijjāṭṭhān'ādi-bhedaṃ sikkhitabb'aṭṭhena sippan'ti saṅkhyaṃ gataṃ sabbaṃ bāhirakasatthaṃ mokkh'āvahasammatam'pi na mokkhaṃ āvahatī'ti āha diṭṭhadhammasamparāyahitan'ti.

examples.text: so'pi brāhmaṇo ācariyamuṭṭhiṃ akatvā ghaṭe udakaṃ āsiñcanto viya sabbam'pi sippaṃ uggaṇhāpetvā te māṇavake etadavoca ettakam'idaṃ sippaṃ diṭṭhadhammasamparāyahitan'ti.

te māṇavakā, yaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyo jānāti, mayam'pi taṃ jānāma, mayam'pi dāni ācariyā evā'ti mānaṃ uppādetvā tato pabhuti ācariye agāravā nikkhittavattā vihariṃsu. ācariyo ñatvā karissāmi nesaṃ mānaniggahan'ti cintesi.

81172.meaning1: bringing (somebody) down to size; keeping (someone's) ego in check

examples.text: te māṇavakā, yaṃ amhākaṃ ācariyo jānāti, mayam'pi taṃ jānāma, mayam'pi dāni ācariyā evā'ti mānaṃ uppādetvā tato pabhuti ācariye agāravā nikkhittavattā vihariṃsu. ācariyo ñatvā karissāmi nesaṃ mānaniggahan'ti cintesi.

81173.meaning1: discerning; able to listen and understand
81173.commentary: (JAa) kaṇṇavā'ti paññavā, kaṇṇachiddaṃ pana na kassaci n'atthi. iti te māṇavake kaṇṇachiddamattameva tumhākaṃ bālānaṃ atthi, na paññā'ti garahitvā pañhaṃ vissajjesi. te sutvā, aho ācariyā nāma mahantā'ti khamāpetvā nihatamānā bodhisattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu.

examples.text: bahūni narasīsāni, lomasāni brahāni ca, gīvāsu paṭimukkāni, koci'd'ev'ettha kaṇṇavā'ti.

81174.meaning1: performance of responsibilities; doing one's duties

examples.text: atha te māṇavakā dīpasahassālokena viya rattiṃ samavisamaṃ ācariyassa vissajjanena pañhassa atthaṃ pākaṭaṃ disvā idāni mayaṃ yāvajīvaṃ guruvāsaṃ vasissāma, mahantā ete ācariyā nāma, mayañ'hi bahussutamānaṃ uppādetvā catuppadikagāthāya'pi atthaṃ na jānāmā'ti nihatamānā pubbasadisam'eva ācariyassa vattappaṭipattiṃ katvā saggaparāyaṇā ahesuṃ.

81175.commentary: (JAa) tass'attho, bahūni narānaṃ sīsāni dissanti, sabbāni ca tāni lomasāni, sabbāni mahantāni gīvāsu'yeva ṭhapitāni, na tālaphalaṃ viya hatthena gahitāni, n'atthi tesaṃ imehi dhammehi nānākaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: bahūni narasīsāni, lomasāni brahāni ca, gīvāsu paṭimukkāni, koci'd'ev'ettha kaṇṇavā'ti.

81176.notes: Kaccāyana (474, 535) takes the root as √har, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jihīrṣati (see MW hṛ). But a more likely candidate is √ji, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jigīṣati (see MW ji).

examples.text: lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanti magganti pariyesantī'ti lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsitāro.
idhā'pi maṃ evaṃ jānanti gopako devaputto gopako devaputto'ti. tumhe pana, mārisā, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ gandhabbakāyaṃ upapannā.

81178.meaning1: should be pierced; should be penetrated

examples.text: aṭṭhivedhapuggalā nām'ete vaṭṭetvā vaṭṭetvā gāḷhaṃ vijjhitabbā'ti cintetvā kutomukhā nāmā'ti-ādīhi vacanehi paṭicodesi.
tesaṃ nisinnānaṃ abhikkamiṃsu, vīrā virāgā virajaṃ karontā, te disvā saṃvegam'akāsi vāsavo, dev'ābhibhū devagaṇassa majjhe.

81180.meaning1: is known; is called; is referred to (as)

examples.text: buddho jan'ind'atthi manussaloke, kām'ābhibhū sakyamunī'ti ñāyati, tass'eva te puttā satiyā vihīnā, coditā mayā te satim'ajjhalatthuṃ.

81181.commentary: (DNa) āvasi'n'ettha eko'ti tattha hīne kāye eko'y'eva āvāsiko jāto.

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ tesaṃ āvasi'n'ettha eko, gandhabbakāy'ūpagato vasīno, dve ca sambodhipath'ānusārino, deve'pi hīḷenti samāhitattā.

81182.notes: Saddanīti takes this as an independent root kele mamāyane. Some take it as √kīḷ. Edgerton notes under kelāyati, 'probably not connected with Skt. keli, but origin obscure'.

examples.text: pabbajitassa hi saddhivihārik'ādayo, gahaṭṭhassa putt'ādayo hatthi-ass'ādayo vā sattā piyā honti keḷāyitā mamāyitā, muhuttam'pi te apassanto adhivāsetuṃ na sakkoti.
appamaṃsalohitattā hi petā aṭṭhisaṅghāṭajaṭitā ekena passena sayituṃ na sakkonti, uttānā'va senti.
ekasmiṃ gantu'kāme eko ṭhātu'kāmo hoti. ekasmiṃ ṭhātu'kāme eko sayitu'kāmo hoti. dve sattā ek'ajjhāsayā nāma dullabhā.

81184.commentary: (DNt) ekasmiṃ gantu'kāme eko ṭhātukāmo hotī'ti idaṃ nidassanavasena vuttaṃ iriyāpathe'pi nāma sattā ek'ajjhāsayā dullabhā, pag'eva laddhīsū'ti dassan'atthaṃ.

examples.text: ekasmiṃ gantu'kāme eko ṭhātu'kāmo hoti. ekasmiṃ ṭhātu'kāme eko sayitu'kāmo hoti. dve sattā ek'ajjhāsayā nāma dullabhā.

81187.meaning1: of the titans; of the asuras

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmassa etadahosi, yā c'eva dāni dibbā ojā yā ca asurā ojā, ubhayam'etaṃ devā paribhuñjissantī'ti.

81188.meaningLit: having caused to increase all around

81190.meaning1: having built up; having cultivated; having increased

examples.text: sacc'ādhiṭṭhān'ādīni cattāri adhiṭṭhānāni paribrūhetvā, puññañāṇasambhāre sambharitvā, pubbayoga-pubbacariya-dhamm'akkhānañāt'atthacariy'ādayo ukkaṃsāpetvā, buddhicariyaṃ paramakoṭiṃ pāpetvā, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhi

81192.commentary: (DNa) samaṃ devehī'ti devehi saddhiṃ, ito paṭṭhāya idāni amhākaṃ brahmuno namakkārakaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti dasseti. sāmaṃ karomā'ti namakkāraṃ karoma. (DNt) sāman'ti sāmaṃpayogaṃ, satthu pana sāvakassa sāmaṃpayogo nāma sanipāto evā'ti āha namakkāraṃ karomā'ti.

examples.text: yaṃ karomasi brahmuno, samaṃ devehi mārisa, tad'ajja tuyhaṃ kassāma, handa sāmaṃ karoma te.
atha kho sakko devānam'indo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbaputtaṃ āmantesi, bah'ūpakāro kho me'si tvaṃ, tāta pañcasikha, yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādesi.
[appiyehi… vippayogo dukkho'ti-pāṭho c'eva taṃniddeso ca katthaci na dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ'pi taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā n'atthi]

81195.meaning1: (gram) in some places; in some contexts

examples.text: [appiyehi… vippayogo dukkho'ti-pāṭho c'eva taṃniddeso ca katthaci na dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ'pi taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā n'atthi]

81196.commentary: (DNa) atthi pana, rājañña, pariyāyo'ti atthi pana kāraṇan'ti pucchati.

examples.text: ayam'pi kho, bho kassapa, pariyāyo, yena me pariyāyena evaṃ hoti, iti'pi n'atthi paro loko, n'atthi sattā opapātikā, n'atthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko'ti.

81197.meaning1: having made a bundle; having bound together

examples.text: so uttar'āsaṅgaṃ pattharitvā pahūtaṃ sukkhagūthaṃ ākiritvā bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā sīse ubbāhetvā agamāsi. tassa antarāmagge mahā-akālamegho pāvassi.

te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa āghātane sīsaṃ chindathā'ti.
